_note: What the herbalism bench makes (docs/herbalism-revamp-plan.md §7). These are the owner-accepted starting values from 2026-10-02, tunable in play. `routes` is every way the form can carry an effect into a body: an effect whose route is not in the list is dropped from the product and the bench says so. `external` is never in any list, because an effect that reaches outside the body is alchemy's (§5.2). `potency` and `duration` multiply on top of the method's. `keeps_minutes` is the shelf life from the minute it is made. Intermediates carry every body route so the form that finishes them decides what stays. Salve, balm and cream multipliers were not given in the plan; balm's longer duration follows its row ('long duration: weather, cold') and the rest are 1.0 until play says otherwise.

poultice.name: Poultice
poultice.action: full-round action; works on the unconscious

infused-oil.name: Infused Oil
infused-oil.taken: not used directly; sold, or mixed into a salve, balm or cream

salve.name: Salve
salve.action: standard action; works on the unconscious

salve-base.name: Salve Base
salve-base.taken: not used directly; mixed with infused oil into a salve, balm or cream

powder.name: Powder
powder.taken: not used directly; brewed, steeped or mixed into a poultice

dried.name: Dried
dried.taken: not used directly; ground, brewed, steeped or infused into oil

extract.name: Extract
extract.taken: not used directly; worked further at the bench

reduction.name: Reduction
reduction.taken: not used directly; reduced again, or worked into a remedy
